Name: Just a Smaller Cursor
Author: nolioblivisci
Description:
Don't like how large and heavy the vanilla cursor looks? Not a fan of paws, leafs and other cutesie cozy things instead of something that's supposed to be functional? Well, try this one, then. Makes your main cursor (aka the one that you see 90% of the time) smaller, more precise and lightweight. 

[Installation]
First time?
Unzip the archive into your Mods folder, and make sure you have the Content Patcher installed.
